medium.title: Foreign Investors Sell Record NT$549.91 Billion in 10 Days
medium.summary: Foreign investors sold NT$549.91 billion worth of Taiwan stocks in just 10 trading days in March, with this week alone seeing NT$237.86 billion in outflows (second-highest weekly outflow on record). Year-to-date foreign selling reached NT$420.19 billion, representing 70% of 2025's full-year outflow.
